original_test_intent: Change one isolated BMC user's authorization for an approved IPMI payload, prove the intended effective allow/deny behavior, and restore the complete original policy.
original_method: Use a protected standard App 0x06/0x4C request with Project-approved user, channel, payload and access bitfields after full baseline capture and explicit confirmation.
manual_activity: Security owner approves the isolated identity, least-privilege change and enforcement assertion; operator confirms the independent admin path and exact baseline immediately before the write.
safety_requirements: Never modify a production or sole-admin identity
Do not clear logs or expose credentials
Read back and restore all fields
agent_execution_scope: Read back and run bounded harmless enforcement check

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct to reject guessed execution, but permanent BLOCKED is unnecessary once the standard 0x4C contract is supplied as Project input.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected App 0x06/0x4C runner with validated bitfields, secret-safe transport, complete readback and guaranteed rollback.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the complete access baseline, validate one isolated 0x4C permission change, confirm, write once, decode readback, prove only the intended allow/deny behavior without leaving a payload active, then restore and independently verify.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a standard, bounded Review-layer implementation without modifying the TBD Master source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Covers only the approved user/channel/payload tuple and cannot establish policy for other identities or payloads.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong bitfields can expose SOL or management access and can remove recovery access.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API may replace raw 0x4C only with equivalent per-field scope, effective authorization proof, audit evidence and complete rollback.
expected_evidence: Validated schema and exact redacted request/response
Restored baseline, unrelated identities and preserved audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master procedure and criteria are TBD and its generic log-clearing step is unsafe for a security-policy change; GPT V2's permanent BLOCKED conclusion overlooks the later standard 0x4C OOB history while correctly identifying missing execution inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standard 0x4C operation resolves core semantics; exact tuple, bitfields, policy, approval and recovery are Project readiness inputs, so review can complete without claiming execution readiness.

review_improvement: Preserves the intended functional write while bounding it to one recoverable least-privilege fixture and complete effective-policy evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is not safely read-only and cannot run from the TBD source alone. The paired OOB history provides a standard command family, but authorization mutation still requires exact policy, isolated identity, recovery and confirmation; therefore REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION is more precise than permanent BLOCKED.
